description: End-to-end QA/QC smoke test for Fleet Commander using Kimi WebBridge to drive the user's real browser and validate every route, button, form, and user-facing interaction from a user perspective. Builds a route/element inventory, drives each route through the kimi-webbridge daemon, captures screenshots, verifies expected behavior, and surfaces findings as new tech-debt rows.

sprint.goal: Run a 100% route-coverage smoke test that touches every user-facing element on every page, validates the click/hover/fill/submit path, captures a screenshot per route, and files one tech-debt row per finding.
sprint.demo_notes: Demonstrate the QA dashboard: total routes covered, total elements exercised, pass/fail breakdown, screenshots archive, TD entries filed.
